title: One-pager (Legal): BrieflyAI - Redwood Inference - Q4 2025
body:
BrieflyAI - Customer One-Pager

Customer: BrieflyAI
Industry segment: Legal
Asset type: One-page success story
Published quarter: Q4 2025

Overview
BrieflyAI builds drafting and review assistance for small law firms. Their team needed a dependable inference layer to support a consistent user experience and a straightforward path through customer security questionnaires.

Why Redwood
- Predictable performance under real user load
- Clear operational visibility for debugging issues
- Vendor materials that reduce friction in procurement/security review

Outcomes (high level)
- Fewer support issues tied to slow or inconsistent AI responses
- Faster internal iteration with fewer rollbacks and less firefighting
- Easier enablement for the sales team with clearer reliability story

Internal tracking
